title: Hall of the Mountain King
use_for: Builds from quiet to loud chaos: escalating rants, situations spiralling out of control.
description: Edvard Grieg's famous piece from Peer Gynt (1876). You know this piece.  Starts quiet - ends loud. This is a "cinematic mix" that is a little sharper than most recordings and less dynamic. Source recordings placed into the Public Domain by the MusOpen project.
